scope: candidate routes lacking production T model or additional E2 product-specific research
notes: Coverage status refers to production engine per docs/BACKLOG.md and studies, not verified APK current inventory.
No cohort aggregate should be used as personal prediction; summary statistics are not necessarily a self-consistent time series.

cohorts.jurisdiction: UK SmPC; not verified French-market listing
cohorts.metric_population: postmenopausal women; geometric means; unadjusted for baseline
caveats: Geometric means of three distinct metrics; not one mean subject.
No baseline correction, no clock time of morning dose, no individual raw series.
Product-specific nonlinearity; no extrapolation beyond 1–3 sprays.

cohorts.product: Xyosted SC TE, titrated 50/75/100 mg weekly
cohorts.metric_population: hypogonadal men; arithmetic mean of titrated-dose mixed cohort at week 12
caveats: Median of individual Tmax is not the maximum time of cohort mean curve.
Different 50/75/100mg doses pooled after titration.
No full numeric individual series; baseline endogenous T unknown.

cohorts.jurisdiction: US FDA historic label; discontinued product
cohorts.claim_note: Patch contains more drug than released dose; 2 or 4 mg/day refers to nominal delivered rate, not patch content.
caveats: Historic formulation not interchangeable with other patches.
Withdrawal curve refers to observed total T return to hypogonadal levels; endogenous baseline remains.
Median peak alone does not identify a time-varying release function.

cohorts.metric_population: titrated mixed-dose hypogonadal men, NaF-EDTA plasma NOT ordinary serum
caveats: Plasma values are not equivalent to serum without assay preparation adjustment.
Food effect is not a universally transferable instantaneous peak scaling.
Lymphatic absorption, meal time, formulation matter.

cohorts.metric_population: transgender men on stable weekly SC T cypionate
caveats: Values at 0/6h/5d/7d are group mean ±SD where given, not individuals.
A pooled mean over seven sampling points is not Cavg via trapezoidal integration.
T cypionate and enanthate must have separate formulation evidence.
Tmax and half-life do not determine peak amplitude or TID basal feedback.
Product specific; fast mucosal pulses.
Material dissolution fractions not systemic T C(t).
Different pellet number and implantation history strongly alter concentrations.
Threshold duration does not define Tmax, trough, baseline, AUC, or post-insertion PK kernel.
Initial vs repeat differences prohibit assuming no accumulation.
Compounded formulation cannot be treated as a standardized commercial implant.

additional_missing_routes.comment: SC cypionate data cannot be directly treated as IM curve
